zh: 希望一张科研概览图同时展示真实视觉输入、空间输出及方法作用
需要参考多图深度估计与几何恢复论文如何组织视觉证据
en: Planning a scientific overview with real inputs, spatial outputs and measured evidence
Studying visual storytelling for depth and geometric reconstruction

zh: 直接展示真实输入照片、深度图、三维几何，不使用模糊图标代替
一个核心模型连接多种输入与可核对的输出
结果统计应服务中心主张，不能脱离原始实验
en: Show real input images, depth maps and geometry rather than abstract icons
Use one central model to connect multiple input modes with evidence
Tie numeric results to experimental context

zh: 官网总览图不等同于论文中逐模块展开的架构图
不应将论文中的定量结果未经核实地挪用于自己的实验
en: An overview teaser is not the same as a detailed module architecture diagram
Do not reuse another paper's quantitative claims as your own

insight.zh: 用多视角图像、深度与 ray map、三维重建和指标建立连续的视觉证据链，让读者先理解空间输出，再理解方法。
insight.en: Inputs, depth/ray maps, 3D reconstruction and metrics form a coherent evidence chain before architectural details.

zh: 顶部以多个视角的序列定义输入，聚焦统一模型而非罗列模块。
深度、光线与点云等不同空间表示通过同一场景串联，信息对应关系明确。
量化比较与视觉重建各司其职，避免用好看的渲染图代替精度结论。
en: The top input sequence frames the any-view setting without module clutter.
The same scene relates depth, ray maps and reconstructed geometry.
Metric plots and rendered results serve separate evidential purposes.

zh: 选出一个具体任务，固定一组同源且视角明确的输入、表示与输出。
使用真实模型预测或实测中间结果；图中明确标记预测与测量的区别。
按论文栏宽测试标签和图像细节是否可读，并给量化结论独立证据。
en: Pick matched, source-grounded inputs, representations and outputs for one task.
Distinguish measured outputs from predictions and do not invent geometry.
Check readability at publication size; support quantitative claims independently.

zh: 官网图片版权仍属于原作者，本站仅链接来源，不表示获取再分发授权。
效果图不能独立证明深度精度、相机姿态性能或跨域泛化。
en: The author's media remains externally linked, not relicensed here.
A teaser alone does not establish depth accuracy, camera-pose precision or generalization.
